question: Who was last Nizam (ruler) of Hyderabad?
solution:
The correct answer is a __**Mir Osman Ali Khan.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mir Osman Ali Khan**

 
 
• ​Mir Osman Ali Khan was the **last Nizam** of the Princely State of Hyderabad.
 
• He ascended the throne on **29 August 1911,** at the age of **25.**
 
• He ruled the Kingdom of Hyderabad between **1911 and 1948** until India annexed it.
 
• He was styled as His Exalted Highness - the Nizam of Hyderabad.
 
• He was widely considered one of the world's wealthiest person of all time.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Nasir-ud-Daula**

 
 
• **​**Mir Farqunda Ali Khan was commonly known as Nasir-ud-Daulah.
 
• He was Nizam of Hyderabad from **24 May 1829 **until his death in **1857**.
 
• The Nizam founded the Hyderabad Medical School in 1846.
 
 
 
• **Mir Mahbub Ali Khan**
 
 
• **​**Asaf Jah VI was also known as **Sir Mir Mahboob Ali Khan** Siddiqi Bayafandi.
 
• He was the **6th Nizam** of Hyderabad.
 
• He ruled Hyderabad state, one of the Princely states in India between 1869 and 1911.
 
 
 
• **Afzal-ud-Daula** 
 
 
• Afzal-ud-Daula was the ruling Nizam of Hyderabad, India, from** 1857 to 1869.**
 
• Asaf Jah V was the eldest son of Nasir-ud-dawlah.
 
• He died in Hyderabad on **26 February 1869**, after a reign of just **12 years.**
